children: Sweden quantitative investment firm's Q2 revenue fell sharply yr/yr, operating loss widened
Management fee revenue rose 74% quarter-on-quarter despite Bitcoin market decline
Company completed SEK 46 mln share issue to fund growth and platform integration
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year in the press release
BITCOIN DECLINE - Co said investment performance remained resilient despite a 14% drop in Bitcoin during the qtr and 26% decline in the first half
MANAGEMENT FEE REVENUE - Management fee revenue rose 74% quarter-on-quarter in USD terms despite Bitcoin market decline
AUM GROWTH - Contracted hedge fund AUM compounded by +136% in Q1 and +8.5% in Q2, with growth in five of the first six months
Aug 28 - Swedish economy posts strong growth, consumers more upbeat ahead of election
